reuse.why: Keeps the existing getDateWithSkippedWeekend call but puts the daily rule beside it in getNextDate instead of in that shared weekend helper used by getUpcomingDates and schedule-template; it also reads dateCond.value where the function otherwise uses value.schedule.data.

duplication.why: The weekend filter under the isDailyWithSkippedWeekends condition is written twice in the same function, once for forward and once for reverse occurrences.

placement.why: shared/schedules.ts is the right module, but the rule is inlined in one caller rather than in the weekend helper every caller uses.

maintainability.why: A magic take of 14, a filter repeated twice, and a rule that only one of the three weekend paths knows about; getUpcomingDates and schedule-template will keep moving daily weekend dates.

bypasses_abstraction.where: shared/schedules.ts getNextDate decides the daily case itself instead of extending getDateWithSkippedWeekend, which server/schedules/app.ts getUpcomingDates and server/budget/schedule-template.ts still rely on unchanged.

disguised_duplication.where: The repeated filter is a plain copy within getNextDate, not disguised.

one_place.where: Rule added only inside shared/schedules.ts getNextDate; getUpcomingDates in server/schedules/app.ts and the schedule-template paths still apply getDateWithSkippedWeekend's move rule to daily schedules.
